definitions.explanation: Being struck with admiration for someone's skill, character, or achievement, to the point of acknowledging oneself outdone. Formal; the thing admired is marked with に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感服|かんぷく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was deeply impressed by his effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感服|かんぷく}⟦いたしました→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I was truly impressed by your remarkable skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{弱音|よわね}→弱音：17446_yowane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}か→吐く：04397_haku⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{感服|かんぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほか⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: She saw it through to the end without once complaining; I can only admire her.

notes:
From ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling) + {服|ぷく} (to submit): admiration that makes one bow to the other person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感服|かんぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be deeply impressed by ～
- {感服|かんぷく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}り: (very formal) I am filled with admiration
- {感服|かんぷく}⟦させられる→する：00392_suru⟧: to be made to admire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感心|かんしん}→感心：02559_kanshin⟧: being impressed, the everyday word, also usable toward juniors
- ⟦{敬服|けいふく}→敬服：21481_keifuku⟧: respect and admiration, even more formal
- ⟦{脱帽|だつぼう}→脱帽：13977_datsubou⟧: taking off one's hat to someone, conceding defeat
